LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 15.1.1 ORAL REPORTS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.1: Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports, part of Strand 15 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you make an oral report presentation interesting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm the content and organisation of an oral report e.g. introduction, body, and conclusion,

2. search online and offline in pairs, the steps for conducting an oral report e.g. research, compile (write), rehearse, and report (present/deliver),

3. role-play methods of delivering oral reports such as clear pronunciation, voice projection, tonal variation, use of non-verbal cues, and use of visuals,

4. use flashcards to prepare speaking notes for the reports,

5. simulate an oral report preparation and delivery procedure and video or audio record themselves,

6. watch or listen to the recorded reports and evaluate them in terms of strengths and weaknesses,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm the content and organisation of an oral report e.g. introduction, body, and conclusion,
2. search online and offline in pairs, the steps for conducting an oral report e.g. research, compile (write), rehearse, and report (present/deliver),
3. role-play methods of delivering oral reports such as clear pronunciation, voice projection, tonal variation, use of non-verbal cues, and use of visuals,
4. use flashcards to prepare speaking notes for the reports,
5. simulate an oral report preparation and delivery procedure and video or audio record themselves,
6. watch or listen to the recorded reports and evaluate them in terms of strengths and weaknesses,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: It is developed as the learner searches online for steps on preparing and presenting reports.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: It is enhanced as the learner evaluates the strengths and weaknesses of their peers’

oral reports.

Values:
Love is enhanced as the learner portrays a caring attitude while evaluating the reports of peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Effective communication is enhanced as learners use verbal and non-verbal reporting skills.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the skill of oral report preparation and presentation to report presentation in Kiswahili.
